card.title: Don’t Question the Premise
card.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The ghost's waiting at our breakfast table. Do we have cereal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it haunting our kitchen? We're already late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give it the instant porridge. I'll find a bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would a dead person need feeding? I'm taking the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it in a travel cup. You can drop it at the cemetery on your way.

mechanism: A turns questions about a ghost's existence and needs into immediate breakfast and transport tasks.
confusable: Unlike persuading B to believe a theory, A avoids why and keeps directing what happens next.
comparison: A commuter's car becomes ghost-and-breakfast transport, while the gallery scene turns leaking-painting questions into containment.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
